agent_priors_used: Sunk-cost / path-dependence prior: frozen scientific transactions have high expected information value already paid for at DESIGN; completing them under frozen design dominates aborting for a speculative pivot unless the frozen question is now known to be non-decision-changing (agent prior, not SPIDER evidence).

Local-optima / tunnel prior: a lane whose recent experiments heavily concentrate on one claim may be in a local optimum; cognitive reset is diagnostic, not a quota — the reset answer is compared against the inherited handoff on decision-value merits (agent prior, not SPIDER evidence).

Value-of-information prior: an experiment whose every outcome branch (win, lose, invalid) changes a concrete architecture or product decision dominates one whose outcomes only refine a narrative (agent prior, not SPIDER evidence).

Shared-blocker consolidation prior: when multiple lanes independently rediscover the same missing substrate or instrument, repairing it once in the owning lane yields higher portfolio information per cycle than another near-duplicate outcome-bearing experiment (agent prior, not SPIDER evidence; consistent with POLICY.md research-efficiency mandate).

Observation-representation prior (labeled PRIOR): a multi-step agent that succeeds at step-0 reveal but re-clicks a hidden button may be failing on observation/action representation rather than raw control capacity; this motivates the already-frozen Intel probe and is NOT a SPIDER experimental finding.

Timescale-band prior (labeled PRIOR): a ~7-minute zero-change census result does not automatically extend to hours-to-days session reuse lags where real product freshness decisions live; the long-window band must be measured, not extrapolated (agent prior, not SPIDER evidence).

allocation.rationale: Frontier is IDLE with no active portfolio mandate and must be explicitly reactivated. The inherited parent handoff is the strongest available direction and wins the cognitive reset on merits. Decision counterfactual: the ~7-minute two-observation census (EXP-FRONTIER-39039638199) certified both deep and shallow strata at a 0.01 structural-text tolerance with 3/3 live positive controls and 35/35 silent nulls, but the hours-to-days / weeks band is explicitly UNDECIDED and the certification is structural-text-channel-only. Real product session reuse lives in the 6 h to 30 d band, not the 7-minute band. If the long window also certifies at 0.01, the product freshness-guard design can drop session-scale structural-text revalidation for this documentation frame class and save real GETs/tokens in C-PRODUCT-ECON and C-FRESHNESS cost models; if it decays into a TTL-shaped requirement, a concrete revalidation interval is licensed by measurement instead of assumption; if it decays into a required guard, the 'is any freshness guard needed at all' product question is answered negatively with a live per-page hazard bound the pre-2.0 program could never produce. Every branch changes a product or architecture decision. Strongest fair baselines are already frozen in the parent design: live positive sensitivity controls, stable null families, in-frame self-pair determinism null, exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson per-page hazard upper bound, and explicit page-gone vs change channel separation — none can be silently weak. Frontier's mission is high-upside falsifiable mechanisms that could change architecture; a live per-page hazard bound on the hours-to-days band is exactly the kind of measurable Web-dynamics object the C-WEB-DYNAMICS registry next_gate names (timescales), and it is independent of the B3-gated external-agent work so it does not stall on Intel's credential question. Cognitive reset performed (Frontier was IDLE, claim_streak 1, no tunnel flag; reset still required by the workflow): if Frontier encountered today's Codex with no inherited next_question, the highest-decision-value available measurement is the hours-to-days staleness band on the already-verified frozen census — the C-CROSSSITE discovery axis is validly closed (0/208, EXP-FRONTIER-38184956362 FALSIFIES), C-CROSSSITE persistence economics is MEASUREMENT_INVALID pending a new substrate, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY internal multi-scale is owned by Product on SBA-V3, and the long-window band is the one open measurement whose every outcome branch changes the freshness-guard product decision. Budget ceiling: one re-frozen long-window second observation with checkpointing across launches; stop if the two DESIGN repairs cannot be verified pre-freeze or if the census frame integrity check fails on the bound observation-0 hash.
